# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  module Toast
    FLASH_VARIANTS = {
      "notice" => :info,
      "alert" => :warning,
      "success" => :success,
      "error" => :error,
      "warning" => :warning,
      "info" => :info
    }.freeze

    def self.flash_variant(key)
      FLASH_VARIANTS[key.to_s] || :default
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Primary action: shadcn's ToastAction (Button outline, size sm). Clicking it
  # also closes the toast (registered divergence: Base UI leaves that to the
  # handler).
  class ToastAction < Base
    def initialize(label:, on: nil, **attrs)
      @label = label
      @on = on
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      render RubyUI::Button.new(variant: :outline, size: :sm, **button_attrs) { @label }
    end

    private

    # slot! makes Button replace its own data-slot="button" instead of joining
    # it. Added after Base's mix, which would strip the bang.
    def button_attrs
      attrs.merge(data: attrs.fetch(:data, {}).merge(slot!: "toast-action"))
    end

    def default_attrs
      actions = [@on, "click->ruby-ui--toast#close"].compact
      {data: {action: actions.join(" ")}, class: "shrink-0"}
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Secondary dismiss button (a RubyUI extra; shadcn's Toast has no cancel).
  class ToastCancel < Base
    def initialize(label:, **attrs)
      @label = label
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      render RubyUI::Button.new(variant: :ghost, size: :sm, **button_attrs) { @label }
    end

    private

    # slot! makes Button replace its own data-slot="button" instead of joining
    # it. Added after Base's mix, which would strip the bang.
    def button_attrs
      attrs.merge(data: attrs.fetch(:data, {}).merge(slot!: "toast-cancel"))
    end

    def default_attrs
      {data: {action: "click->ruby-ui--toast#dismiss"}, class: "shrink-0"}
    end
  end
end

module RubyUI
  # shadcn's ToastClose: a ghost icon-sm Button in the toast row, with a
  # larger hit area (after:-inset-2).
  class ToastClose < Base
    def view_template
      render RubyUI::Button.new(variant: :ghost, size: :icon_sm, **button_attrs) do
        svg(
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          width: "24",
          height: "24",
          viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
          fill: "none",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          stroke_width: "2",
          stroke_linecap: "round",
          stroke_linejoin: "round",
          aria_hidden: "true"
        ) do |s|
          s.path(d: "M18 6 6 18")
          s.path(d: "m6 6 12 12")
        end
      end
    end

    private

    # slot! makes Button replace its own data-slot="button" instead of joining
    # it. Added after Base's mix, which would strip the bang.
    def button_attrs
      attrs.merge(data: attrs.fetch(:data, {}).merge(slot!: "toast-close"))
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        aria_label: "Close toast",
        data: {action: "click->ruby-ui--toast#dismiss"},
        class: "relative shrink-0 text-muted-foreground after:absolute after:-inset-2 after:content-[''] hover:text-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class ToastIcon < Base
    def initialize(variant: nil, **attrs)
      @variant = variant&.to_sym
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template
      return unless renderable?
      span(**attrs) do
        svg(
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          width: "16",
          height: "16",
          viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
          fill: "none",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          stroke_width: "2",
          stroke_linecap: "round",
          stroke_linejoin: "round",
          class: svg_classes,
          aria_hidden: "true"
        ) { |s| paths(s) }
      end
    end

    private

    def renderable?
      %i[success error warning info loading].include?(@variant)
    end

    def svg_classes
      case @variant
      when :loading then "size-4 animate-spin"
      when :error then "size-4 text-destructive"
      else "size-4"
      end
    end

    def paths(s)
      case @variant
      when :success
        s.circle(cx: "12", cy: "12", r: "10")
        s.path(d: "m9 12 2 2 4-4")
      when :error
        s.path(d: "M2.586 16.726A2 2 0 0 1 2 15.312V8.688a2 2 0 0 1 .586-1.414l4.688-4.688A2 2 0 0 1 8.688 2h6.624a2 2 0 0 1 1.414.586l4.688 4.688A2 2 0 0 1 22 8.688v6.624a2 2 0 0 1-.586 1.414l-4.688 4.688a2 2 0 0 1-1.414.586H8.688a2 2 0 0 1-1.414-.586z")
        s.path(d: "m15 9-6 6")
        s.path(d: "m9 9 6 6")
      when :warning
        s.path(d: "m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.48 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3")
        s.path(d: "M12 9v4")
        s.path(d: "M12 17h.01")
      when :info
        s.circle(cx: "12", cy: "12", r: "10")
        s.path(d: "M12 16v-4")
        s.path(d: "M12 8h.01")
      when :loading
        s.path(d: "M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-6.219-8.56")
      end
    end

    def default_attrs
      {data: {slot: "toast-icon"}, class: "shrink-0 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"}
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # One toast. Mirrors shadcn's Base UI Toast (role=dialog, aria-modal=false,
  # named by its title and described by its description) and wraps the block
  # in Base UI's ToastContent row.
  #
  # on_dismiss / on_remove take Stimulus action descriptors ("undo#commit")
  # bound to the toast's own ruby-ui:toast:close / ruby-ui:toast:remove events,
  # so the named controller must be on the toast or an ancestor.
  class ToastItem < Base
    PRIORITIES = %i[low high].freeze
    REMOVED_KWARGS = %i[invert on_auto_close].freeze

    def initialize(
      variant: :default,
      id: nil,
      duration: nil,
      dismissible: true,
      priority: :low,
      on_dismiss: nil,
      on_remove: nil,
      **attrs
    )
      removed = attrs.keys & REMOVED_KWARGS
      unless removed.empty?
        raise ArgumentError, "RubyUI::ToastItem: #{removed.map { |k| "#{k}:" }.join(", ")} " \
          "#{(removed.size == 1) ? "was" : "were"} removed (it never had an effect). See the Toast changelog."
      end

      @variant = variant.to_sym
      @id = id
      @duration = duration
      @dismissible = dismissible
      @priority = priority.to_sym
      raise ArgumentError, "RubyUI::ToastItem: priority must be :low or :high" unless PRIORITIES.include?(@priority)

      @on_dismiss = on_dismiss
      @on_remove = on_remove
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs) do
        div(data: {slot: "toast-content"}, class: content_classes, &)
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      actions = []
      actions << "ruby-ui:toast:close->#{@on_dismiss}" if @on_dismiss
      actions << "ruby-ui:toast:remove->#{@on_remove}" if @on_remove
      data = {
        slot: "toast",
        type: @variant.to_s,
        variant: @variant.to_s,
        priority: @priority.to_s,
        state: "pending",
        swipe: "none",
        controller: "ruby-ui--toast",
        ruby_ui__toaster_target: "toast",
        ruby_ui__toast_dismissible_value: @dismissible.to_s
      }
      data[:action] = actions.join(" ") unless actions.empty?
      data[:ruby_ui__toast_duration_value] = @duration.to_s if @duration
      a = {
        role: (@priority == :high) ? "alertdialog" : "dialog",
        aria_modal: "false",
        tabindex: "0",
        data: data,
        class: item_classes
      }
      a[:id] = @id if @id
      a
    end

    # Base UI + vega toast root. The stacking transforms, heights and z-index
    # come from the toaster controller (inline styles), not CSS variables.
    def item_classes
      <<~CLASSES.tr("\n", " ").squeeze(" ").strip
        group/toast pointer-events-auto absolute inset-x-0 w-full
        rounded-2xl border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-lg
        will-change-transform outline-none select-none
        focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50
        transition-[transform,opacity,height] duration-500 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)]
        motion-reduce:transition-none
        data-[swipe=move]:transition-none
        data-[state=pending]:[transform:translateY(150%)]
        in-data-[position^=top]:data-[state=pending]:[transform:translateY(-150%)]
        data-[limited]:opacity-0 data-[limited]:pointer-events-none
        after:absolute after:top-full after:left-0 after:h-[13px] after:w-full after:content-['']
        before:absolute before:bottom-full before:left-0 before:h-[13px] before:w-full before:content-['']
      CLASSES
    end

    def content_classes
      "flex h-full items-center gap-3 overflow-hidden p-4 transition-opacity duration-250 " \
        "ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)] group-data-[behind]/toast:opacity-0"
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The toast viewport: a fixed, labelled live region that hosts the toasts.
  # Mount it once per page (layout). Mirrors shadcn's Base UI Toaster
  # (toast-viewport); positions other than bottom-right are a RubyUI extra.
  #
  # The region is a popover="manual" so each new toast can lift it into the
  # top layer, above a RubyUI Dialog/Sheet opened with showModal().
  class ToastRegion < Base
    SKELETON_VARIANTS = %i[default success error warning info loading].freeze
    POSITIONS = %i[top_left top_center top_right bottom_left bottom_center bottom_right].freeze
    SWIPE_DIRECTIONS = %i[up down left right].freeze
    REMOVED_KWARGS = %i[offset theme rich_colors dir].freeze

    def initialize(
      position: :bottom_right,
      expand: false,
      max: 3,
      duration: 5000,
      gap: 12,
      close_button: true,
      hotkey: %w[F6],
      swipe_directions: nil,
      flash: nil,
      **attrs
    )
      removed = attrs.keys & REMOVED_KWARGS
      unless removed.empty?
        raise ArgumentError, "RubyUI::ToastRegion: #{removed.map { |k| "#{k}:" }.join(", ")} " \
          "#{(removed.size == 1) ? "was" : "were"} removed (it never had an effect). See the Toast changelog."
      end

      @position = position.to_sym
      raise ArgumentError, "RubyUI::ToastRegion: unknown position #{position.inspect}" unless POSITIONS.include?(@position)

      @expand = expand
      @max = max
      @duration = duration
      @gap = gap
      @close_button = close_button
      @hotkey = hotkey
      @swipe_directions = swipe_directions && Array(swipe_directions).map(&:to_sym)
      unknown = Array(@swipe_directions) - SWIPE_DIRECTIONS
      raise ArgumentError, "RubyUI::ToastRegion: unknown swipe direction(s) #{unknown.inspect}" unless unknown.empty?
      @flash = flash
      super(**attrs)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      div(**attrs) do
        div(id: "ruby-ui-toaster", class: "relative") do
          render_flash if @flash
          yield(self) if block
        end
        SKELETON_VARIANTS.each { |v| skeleton(v) }
        slot_template("actionTpl") { render RubyUI::ToastAction.new(label: "") }
        slot_template("cancelTpl") { render RubyUI::ToastCancel.new(label: "") }
        slot_template("closeTpl") { render RubyUI::ToastClose.new }
      end
    end

    private

    def render_flash
      @flash.each do |key, message|
        next if message.nil? || message.to_s.empty?
        variant = RubyUI::Toast.flash_variant(key)
        render RubyUI::ToastItem.new(variant: variant, id: "flash-#{key}") do
          render RubyUI::ToastIcon.new(variant: variant)
          div(class: "flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1") do
            render RubyUI::ToastTitle.new { message.to_s }
          end
          render RubyUI::ToastClose.new if @close_button
        end
      end
    end

    def skeleton(variant)
      template(data: {ruby_ui__toaster_target: "skeleton", variant: variant.to_s}) do
        render RubyUI::ToastItem.new(variant: variant) do
          render RubyUI::ToastIcon.new(variant: variant)
          div(class: "flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1") do
            render RubyUI::ToastTitle.new
            render RubyUI::ToastDescription.new
          end
          render RubyUI::ToastClose.new if @close_button
        end
      end
    end

    def slot_template(target_name, &)
      template(data: {ruby_ui__toaster_target: target_name}, &)
    end

    def default_attrs
      position = @position.to_s.tr("_", "-")
      data = {
        slot: "toast-viewport",
        controller: "ruby-ui--toaster",
        turbo_permanent: "",
        position: position,
        ruby_ui__toaster_position_value: position,
        ruby_ui__toaster_expand_value: @expand.to_s,
        ruby_ui__toaster_max_value: @max.to_s,
        ruby_ui__toaster_duration_value: @duration.to_s,
        ruby_ui__toaster_gap_value: @gap.to_s,
        ruby_ui__toaster_close_button_value: @close_button.to_s,
        ruby_ui__toaster_hotkey_value: Array(@hotkey).join("+")
      }
      # "none" disables swipe; leaving it unset derives it from the position.
      if @swipe_directions
        data[:ruby_ui__toaster_swipe_directions_value] = @swipe_directions.empty? ? "none" : @swipe_directions.join(" ")
      end
      {
        id: "ruby-ui-toaster-region",
        role: "region",
        aria_label: "Notifications",
        aria_live: "polite",
        aria_relevant: "additions text",
        aria_atomic: "false",
        tabindex: "-1",
        popover: "manual",
        data: data,
        class: region_classes
      }
    end

    # Base UI's toast-viewport classes (bottom-right), plus resets for the
    # popover UA styles (inset: 0, margin: auto, border, padding, background)
    # and the other five positions.
    def region_classes
      <<~CLASSES.tr("\n", " ").squeeze(" ").strip
        pointer-events-none fixed z-50 m-0 h-auto w-auto max-w-sm overflow-visible
        border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-inherit outline-none
        inset-x-4 mx-auto sm:mx-0 sm:w-full
        data-[position^=bottom]:top-auto data-[position^=bottom]:bottom-4
        data-[position^=top]:top-4 data-[position^=top]:bottom-auto
        data-[position$=right]:sm:right-4 data-[position$=right]:sm:left-auto
        data-[position$=left]:sm:left-4 data-[position$=left]:sm:right-auto
        data-[position$=center]:sm:left-1/2 data-[position$=center]:sm:right-auto data-[position$=center]:sm:-translate-x-1/2
      CLASSES
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The toast's heading; the toast is named by it (aria-labelledby, wired by
  # the toast controller). Base UI renders an <h2>.
  class ToastTitle < Base
    def view_template(&)
      h2(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {data: {slot: "toast-title"}, class: "text-sm font-medium"}
    end
  end
end
